editorial:
You get another wild night at the museum, but this time the magic is fading and Larry has to travel to London to fix it. Ben Stiller leads a big cast of funny museum exhibits, and the movie keeps the playful energy fans expect. It feels like a family adventure with silly jokes, big set pieces, and heart. The story moves quickly from New York to London, giving you fresh places to explore while keeping the familiar characters front and center.

The action is lively, the new characters add fun, and the emotional ending lands well. Some jokes feel familiar and the story can be busy, but it still delivers laughs and wonder. If you want a light family movie, this is a really good pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Larry and his friends use the Tablet of Ahkmenrah to restore the fading magic, but the tablet must stay in the British Museum. Larry says goodbye to the exhibits as they come alive one last time, then returns home. The twist is that the magic continues in London, while Larry keeps his memories and a new chapter begins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves family adventures and silly museum comedy.
